description: This file defines an interface 'TimeoutConfig' used for configuring timeout strategies with methods to retrieve minimum and maximum timeout durations. It also contains an enumeration 'TimeoutConfigValue' that provides configuration path expressions and default timeout duration values.

classes.name: TimeoutConfig
classes.description: An interface providing methods to retrieve minimum and maximum timeout durations.

classes.name: TimeoutConfig.TimeoutConfigValue
classes.description: An enum implementing KnownConfigValue, providing configuration path expressions and default timeout duration values for the TimeoutConfig.

methods.name: getMinTimeout
methods.description: Returns the minimum timeout duration used in timeout strategies.

methods.name: getMaxTimeout
methods.description: Returns the maximum timeout duration used in timeout strategies.
